description: This file declares the HeartbeatProcedure class and its associated factory and handler classes, which are part of the server-side heartbeat mechanism in the Rialto media server. It defines interfaces for creating and managing heartbeat procedures, including handling ping signals and errors.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedureFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HeartbeatProcedure instances, implementing the IHeartbeatProcedureFactory interface.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Implements the heartbeat logic, manages ping signals, and handles heartbeat events.

classes.name: HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Inner class within HeartbeatProcedure that handles individual heartbeat events such as ping sent and error.

methods.name: createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with the given acknowledgment sender and ping ID.

methods.name: createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new heartbeat handler for a specific control ID.

methods.name: pingSent
methods.description: Indicates that a ping has been sent.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles an error event in the heartbeat process.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the heartbeat.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the heartbeat process for a given control ID.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Completes the heartbeat process, recording success or failure.
